# opnsense_interfaces_loopback (Resource)

Loopback interfaces (Interfaces > Devices > Loopback), e.g. for a router ID or a service address. Assign the device with `opnsense_interfaces_assignment` to give it an address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_interfaces_loopback" "router_id" {
  description = "BGP router ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `device` (String) Device name assigned by OPNsense, e.g. `lo1`.
- `id` (String) UUID of the loopback.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_interfaces_loopback.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
